method: Compare against all existing titles and aliases without artist; ignore punctuation, accents, recording suffixes, leading numbering and guest credits. Preserve explicit major key and chord quality. Exclude affected sections when notation is unclear; stop before key changes. Community-source badges are recorded separately from conversion checks. No independent recording verification and no lyrics or audio imported.
